'
Neath Canadian Skies
is a 1946 American
Northern
film about
Mounties
.
[
1
]
It was directed by
B. Reeves Eason
from a story by
James Oliver Curwood
. Filming took place in June 1946 through Golden Gate Pictures, in a studio that used to be a ping pong parlor.
[
2
]
The same team also made
North of the Border
(1946).
